welcome: Welcome to PATI Group, the ultimate destination for individuals aspiring to build a thriving career in eCommerce.
aboutShort: PATI is a fast-growing E-commerce business specializing in supporting dietary supplement businesses, achieving a remarkable 500% increase in sales within just one year in the United States market.
vision: By 2026, PATI will be the leading dietary supplement company in Vietnam, offering innovative and high-quality products. We aim to inspire our customers to change their lifestyles and optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.
visionGoals: NPS of Wellness Nest & Miracle Mushroom > 90%
aboutLead: At PATI Group, we live by our company values, fostering an inspiring culture for our people. Our values are fundamental to our mission – they guide us in delivering excellence for our customers, our team, and our partners. We have three core values

values.name: Honor Our Word
behaviors: Execute Diligently Agreed Commitments With Quality & Deadline
Remind Teammates, Inform Stakeholders Promptly Of Commitment Gap
Acknowledge Commitment Gaps: Inform, Take Responsibility, Recommit Immediately

values.name: Play Like A Teamsport
behaviors: Start With SMART Goal, Close With Action Plan
Guide, Collaborate And Share Experience For Team Success
Recognize Efforts And Behaviors Promptly, Regardless of Result

values.name: Foster Innovation
behaviors: Welcome New Ideas With Open Ears And Mind
Pursue Wisdom Proactively: Learn and Share Insightful Knowledge
Try Fast, Fail Fast, And Learn Fast Fearlessly
